recreation_brief: 1. Create a slide with a light gray background (#F2F2F2) and add a thin gray border around the slide frame. 2. Insert a centered text box in the vertical middle of the slide. 3. Type the title on three lines exactly: 'Example: Obtain Minimum Value', 'of a function using', 'Gradient Descent (GD)'. 4. Format the text as bold, red (#C00000), sans-serif, centered, with a large font size. 5. In the top-right corner, draw a small circle filled yellow (#FFFF00) with a thin dark outline. 6. Place the number '29' inside the circle in small dark text, centered.
